other_process_rule: If GPU2 has any other compute process at preflight, stop without launching.

arms.A: Official vendored vLLM GPU executor and default FCFS scheduler
arms.B: The exact stage2 scheduler-managed PyTorch executor and explicit KV ledger with the same default FCFS scheduler

required_outcomes: Every main request emits exactly the frozen output token count; warmup is reported separately.
A and B execute the same request IDs, prompt hashes, batch sizes, prefill chunks and output counts.
Record per-case wall time, scheduler/engine steps, execute_model time, forward time where available, KV/recompute/swap accounting and run order.
Record token-ID divergence separately; it is not hidden by equal output lengths.
All registered processes exit and only study-owned GPU2 resources are checked for release.
interpretation: Tiny backend calibration only. It does not estimate a JITServe policy effect, a C mechanism effect, statistical equivalence or general system superiority.
next_gate: Implement and semantically accept C on the exact B backend, then run a small B/C comparison. Do not restore the formal public-trace/DEV matrix until that small B/C result exists and is interpretable.
